snippet.title: Survival Auto Battler Game | Before I Turn: Survival Auto Battler | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
You've been bitten. Hours before you turn. All you have left: a clock running out and a deserted hospital lab. Identify the virus, synthesize your antiviral, and test it. But every win teaches it to resist you. Before I Turn blends survival, auto battler and simulation into one experience.

Avaliable on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5112500/Before_I_Turn_Survival_Auto_Battler/

#survival #autobattler #simulation
